camel_example: aliyun ice DeleteMediaInfos --region cn-hangzhou --DeletePhysicalFiles false --MediaIds '000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000,000015d4a4b0448391508f2cb4860000' --InputURLs 'http_s_://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp40' --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Deletes media asset information in batches. A maximum of 20 media assets can be deleted at a time. If MediaIds is not empty, MediaIds takes precedence. If MediaIds is empty, InputURLs must not be empty
description_zh: 批量删除媒资信息，最多一次删20个。MediaIds不为空时，优先使用MediaIds。如果MediaIds为空，则InputURLs必须非空
name: DeleteMediaInfos

parameters.help_en: The IMS media asset IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). If the MediaIds parameter is empty, the InputURLs parameter must not be empty
parameters.help_zh:
IMS 媒资ID
多个用英文逗号分隔。

若MediaIds 字段为空，则InputURLs字段必须不为空
parameters.name: media_ids

parameters.help_en: The URLs of the media assets to be deleted in the corresponding system. The files corresponding to the URLs must be registered in IMS first. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). Two formats are supported: 1. http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4? 2. OSS://example-bucket/example.mp4? In the second format, the default OSS region is the same as the service registration area
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的媒资在相应系统中的地址，该地址对应的文件需要先在IMS中注册，多个URL用英文逗号分隔。
支持两种格式
http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4?
OSS://example-bucket/example.mp4?  
此格式默认OSS region与服务接入区域一致
parameters.name: input_urls

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the physical files of the media assets. If the storage address of a media asset is a user-owned OSS bucket, you must authorize the AliyunICEDefaultRole service role in advance<props="china">. For more information, see Delete recorded files (OSS authorization management) (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ims/user-guide/record#0737d9c437bmn)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除媒资的物理文件。

若媒资的存储地址是用户自有oss，需对服务角色AliyunICEDefaultRole提前进行授权<props="china">，具体操作请参见删除录制文件说明（OSS授权管理） (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/record?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i8#0737d9c437bmn)</props>
parameters.name: delete_physical_files

ForbiddenList.description_en: The list of media asset IDs or URLs (exactly as entered) that cannot be deleted. This is generally caused by a lack of permissions
ForbiddenList.description_zh: 不可删除的媒资ID或URL（与用户输入一致）列表。一般由于无权限导致

items.description_en: The media asset ID or URL (exactly as entered) that cannot be deleted
items.description_zh: 不可删除的媒资ID或URL（与用户输入一致）

IgnoredList.description_en: The list of IDs or input URLs (exactly as entered) that encountered errors
IgnoredList.description_zh: 出现获取错误的ID或InputURL（与用户输入一致）列表

items.description_en: The ID or input URL (exactly as entered) that encountered an error
items.description_zh: 出现获取错误的ID或InputURL（与用户输入一致）
